# Synthetic Human Edit Records

This cumulative file uses one globally randomized, quota-exact allocation across 100 videos. Records become final only after direct full-video review.

- Global allocation: 100 videos / 300 edit records
- Directly reviewed and finalized: 100 videos / 300 edit records
- Current status: all videos 001-100 are directly reviewed and final
- Timing: E1 < 20.0 seconds; E2A/E2B >= 20.0 and < 37.0 seconds; E1-to-E2B <= 15.0 seconds
- Global branch-to-primary Cramer's V: 0.023837

## Global Primary-Type Targets

| Primary type | Target |
|---|---:|
| Motion | 90 |
| Attribute | 60 |
| Spatial | 45 |
| Composition | 45 |
| Camera | 30 |
| Style | 22 |
| Temporal | 8 |
